from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single court document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the court document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action as stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The general category of the document, e.g., Administrative or Civil")
    evidence_quote: str | None = Field(description="Excerpt from the text confirming the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for extracted information from one document instance."""
    judgments: list[DocumentInfo]
